name: Coupon Boost for WooCommerce
author: nouthemes

sections.description:
Coupon Boost for WooCommerce supercharges your store’s coupon system with 14 powerful features designed to boost sales, reward customers, and create sophisticated discount strategies.

Core Features

BOGO Deals (Buy One Get One)
* Buy X Get X (same product)
* Buy X Get Y (different products)
* Buy X Get Cheapest free
* Flexible quantity triggers
* Repeat limits and auto-add to cart
* Free, percentage, or fixed discounts

URL Coupons
* Apply coupons automatically via URL
* Perfect for email campaigns
* Session-based pending coupons
* One-click coupon application

Coupon Scheduler
* Schedule start date and time
* Set expiry with precision
* Daily time range restrictions
* Day-of-week restrictions
* Timezone support
* Auto-activation via cron

Advanced Restrictions
* User role restrictions
* Customer location (country/state)
* Payment method requirements
* Shipping method requirements
* Order history rules
* First order only deals

Tiered Discounts
* Volume-based pricing
* Cart total based discounts
* Stackable discount tiers
* Quantity-based pricing

Stacked Rewards
* Free gift products with coupons
* Auto-add to cart
* Flexible configurations

Management & Organization

Coupon Categories
* Organize coupons by category
* Tag system (Flash Sale, Holiday, VIP)
* Filter and manage easily

Import/Export
* Bulk import coupons from CSV
* Export coupons to CSV
* Streamline coupon management

Dashboard & Reports
* Coupon usage statistics
* Revenue by coupon analysis
* Top customers report
* Real-time analytics

Design & Display

Coupon Designs
* Multiple design templates
* Frontend coupon display
* Email template integration
* Custom branding options

Print Coupons
* Printable coupon designs
* Multiple design templates
* Terms page support
* Print-friendly layouts

QR Code Generation
* Generate QR codes for coupon URLs
* PNG format support
* Customizable size and colors
* URL encoding for easy sharing

Available Coupons Display
* Show available coupons on cart/checkout
* WooCommerce Blocks support
* Customer-facing coupon list
* Encourage coupon usage

Store Notice Coupon
* Store-wide coupon announcements
* Promotional banner
* Configurable display

Additional Features

Attribute Restrictions
* Restrict by product attributes
* Brand, color, size filtering
* Category-based restrictions

Order History Rules
* Restrict based on order count
* Restrict based on total spent
* First-time customer targeting

Technical Excellence

  • HPOS Compatible – High-Performance Order Storage ready
  • WooCommerce Blocks – Full Gutenberg support
  • Performance Optimized – Efficient caching and queries
  • Developer Friendly – Extensive hooks and filters
  • Translation Ready – Fully translatable
  • Regular Updates – Active development and support

Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores of all sizes
  • Marketing campaigns and promotions
  • Customer loyalty programs
  • Seasonal sales and flash deals
  • Wholesale and B2B discounts
  • Subscription-based rewards
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.4 or greater
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or greater
  • PHP version 7.4 or greater

Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Coupon Boost for WooCommerce”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

After Activation

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Coupons
  2. Create a new coupon or edit existing ones
  3. Explore the new Coupon Boost features in the coupon editor
  4. Visit Coupon Boost dashboard for reports and settings
sections.faq:
Is this compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes! Coupon Boost is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Does it work with WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes! The plugin fully supports WooCommerce Blocks including the Available Coupons block.

Can I import/export coupons?

Yes! Use the Import/Export feature to bulk manage coupons via CSV files.

How do URL coupons work?

URL coupons allow customers to apply coupons automatically by clicking a special link. Perfect for email campaigns and social media promotions.

Can I schedule coupons?

Yes! Set start dates, expiry dates, daily time ranges, and day-of-week restrictions for your coupons.

What are BOGO deals?

BOGO (Buy One Get One) deals let you create flexible promotions like “Buy 2 Get 1 Free” or “Buy Product A Get Product B at 50% off”.

Can I customize coupon appearance?

Yes! The plugin includes multiple coupon design templates (Classic, Modern, Cutout, Minimal, Premium, Festive) with customizable colors and styles.

Can I restrict coupons by user role?

Yes! Restrict coupons by user role, location, payment method, shipping method, order history, and more.

Does it support tiered discounts?

Yes! Create volume-based pricing with multiple discount tiers based on cart total or quantity.

Can I generate QR codes for coupons?

Yes! Generate QR codes for coupon URLs in PNG format with customizable size and colors.
